execution.cost_basis: absolute executed buy/sell notional; both legs charged separately
execution.unavailable_open: no fabricated close fill; stop and report unresolved order
execution.execution_review_required: Audit gap exposure, drift-aware turnover, cash/fees and adjustment basis before Day 3; shifted close-to-close returns do not prove open execution

samples.actual: Only actual listed ETF history with a common valid warmup; no synthetic prelisting prices
samples.s6: Only independently verified point-in-time coverage; S1/S6 comparison uses common dates only

data_rules.adjusted_close_and_open: Preserve both raw provider Open/Close and Adj Close; document any derived adjustment and avoid dividend double counting
data_rules.missing_values: No implicit forward/backfill, silent universe deletion or shortened warmup
data_rules.current_day: Exclude 2026-09-18 session; explicit download end is exclusive
data_rules.timezone: Preserve provider timezone; audit exchange session mapping on Day 2

selection_gates_verbatim:
모든 하드 게이트를 통과해야 후보로 남는다.

- 데이터 누수, 미래 유니버스, 동일일 종가 체결, 미설명 결측 처리: 즉시 탈락.
- 25bp 편도 비용에서 주문이 정의되지 않거나 성과가 기준선보다 일관되게 열세: 탈락.
- 세 표본외 구간 중 두 구간 이상에서 SPY 또는 60/40 대비 비용 후 Calmar가 열세: 탈락.
- PBO가 0.20 초과 또는 Deflated Sharpe Ratio가 0.95 미만: "탐색"으로만 보관하고 paper trading
  후보에서는 제외.
- S6은 S1보다 두 개 이상의 표본외 구간에서 개선되고 부트스트랩 개선 확률이 60% 이상일 때만
  S1을 대체할 수 있다. 그렇지 않으면 새틀라이트는 paper shadow sleeve로만 유지한다.

남은 후보 중 순위는 비용 후 Calmar, bootstrap 중앙값, 최악 3개월, turnover 순서로 매긴다.
최종 두 전략은 월 수익률 상관 0.75 미만이어야 하며, 조건을 만족하지 않으면 하나만 또는 0개를
선택한다.

unresolved_blockers.subject: Incomplete preregistered implementation choices
unresolved_blockers.detail: Protocol does not specify S5 tickers/lookback/weighting, precise S6 pool/selection/entry-exit rules, calendar versus trading-day month conventions, or baseline rebalance schedules. Existing Champion has additional filters and cannot supply missing choices by silent inheritance.
unresolved_blockers.resolution: Recover the pre-existing authoritative specification. If none exists, obtain an explicit clarification before freezing; do not optimize or add candidates.

unresolved_blockers.subject: Long proxy panel cannot support first OOS window with the allowed proxy alone
unresolved_blockers.detail: Existing 17 ETF universe includes XLRE. Observed XLRE price history begins 2015-10-08. XLC->VOX alone therefore cannot supply a 12-month warmed-up common panel within 2007-2015. No XLRE substitution is authorized.
unresolved_blockers.resolution: Locate an already preregistered resolution or leave this experiment blocked for owner clarification. Do not invent XLRE->IYR, backfill prelisting prices, drop XLRE, or weaken the OOS gate.

unresolved_blockers.subject: S6 point-in-time inputs not frozen with sufficient provenance
unresolved_blockers.detail: Local membership table has unknown upstream retrieval time/revisions, ends 2026-06-30, and has no frozen point-in-time sectors, share publication timestamps or delisted prices. Existing sampler uses current sectors and earliest future shares when past shares are unavailable.
unresolved_blockers.resolution: Establish an independently verifiable, bounded point-in-time input panel for the already specified S6 methodology. Do not claim currently cached data or current membership establishes past availability.
